title: 📊 Analysis Reports
content:
# 📊 Analysis Reports

**Folder for generated analysis outputs**

---

## 📁 Contents

This folder contains all analysis reports generated by the autonomous system.

### **Current Reports:**

```
✅ ANALIZA_LEGAL_FULL.txt      (7.9KB) - Legal analysis of CBA reports
✅ ANALIZA_RISK_FULL.txt       (6.8KB) - Risk analysis
✅ ANALIZA_ARCHITECT_FULL.txt  (5.4KB) - Architectural analysis
✅ ANALIZA_CBA_2008-2024.md           - Guide to analyses
✅ profound_test_*.json               - Test metrics
✅ profound_test_output.log           - Test execution log
```

---

## 🔒 Git Ignore

This folder is added to `.gitignore` - reports won't be committed to git.

**Why?**
- Reports are generated outputs (not source code)
- Can be regenerated anytime
- May contain sensitive analysis data
- Keeps repository clean

---

## 🚀 How to Regenerate

```bash
# Run analysis on your documents:
python3 destiny_auto.py testdocsLLM

# Or run profound test:
python3 profound_test.py

# Reports will be saved here automatically
```

---

## 📖 How to Read

```bash
# Open in editor:
open ANALIZA_LEGAL_FULL.txt

# View in terminal:
cat ANALIZA_LEGAL_FULL.txt

# With pagination:
less ANALIZA_LEGAL_FULL.txt
```

---

**Note:** This folder is auto-managed. Old reports may be overwritten by new analyses.
